verdict.rationale: Airweave lets agents search synced data through tools they invoke themselves: the MCP server, agent-driven tool-calling search, LlamaIndex and Vercel AI SDK tools, and official skills. That covers the 'search' part of the story. However, its data comes from syncing source connections, not from agents writing memories. Pipedream actions to 'manage collections' and 'trigger syncs' are collection- and sync-level operations, not memory CRUD. Missing for 10: agent-invoked tools or API calls to add, update and delete individual memories mid-conversation, plus any evidence of a dedicated memory store separate from synced source data.
